description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Cost of Living Index Number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade for the Month of October 2016 being 114.8, the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of November, 2016 will be Rs. 649.08
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper trade, determined by the Cost of Living Index Number. It is issued under the Wages Boards Ordinance and relates to public sector service conditions and benefits, specifically the remuneration of workers. This falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8), which cover public service recruitment, service conditions, benefits, and salary revisions.
